name: TeX Live
description: Installs TeX Live on Debian/Ubuntu, Red Hat/Fedora, or Alpine based systems via the official TUG installer.

packages.description: Space-separated list of additional TeX Live packages to install after the base scheme (e.g. 'latexmk biber').

release.description: TeX Live release year to install (e.g. '2026', '2025', '2024') or 'latest' for the current release.

mirror.description: Custom TeX Live mirror URL pointing to a tlnet directory (e.g. 'https://mirror.example.com/ctan/systems/texlive/tlnet'). Overrides the automatic mirror selection.
